items.title: Via announces expansion of its on-demand service to twelve new US counties
items.excerpt: Via, the transit technology company, today announced… The company says the deployments will begin in Q4 and cover rural areas previously served by fixed routes.
items.trap: press release about a watched company

items.title: The state of European mobility in 2026: a 40-page review
items.excerpt: Our annual review covers micromobility, rail investment, EV charging, MaaS platforms and urban logistics. A short section notes that demand-responsive transport remains a niche in most member states.

items.title: Lincolnshire extends its dial-a-ride contract by two years
items.excerpt: The county council confirmed the extension on Tuesday. The service carried 41,000 passengers last year.

items.title: Barcelona announces the finalists of its architecture prize
items.excerpt: Six practices remain in contention for the 2026 award. The jury will announce the winner in September.

items.title: New EU regulation tightens rules on public transport tender awards
items.excerpt: The regulation, published in the Official Journal, changes how contracting authorities must evaluate operator bids from January. It applies to all PSO contracts above €2m.

items.title: Padam Mobility and Keolis renew their partnership in Occitanie
items.excerpt: The two companies will continue to operate four DRT zones. Keolis said ridership grew 18% year on year.

items.title: Paris to add 1,200 e-scooter parking bays
items.excerpt: The city says the bays will reduce pavement clutter. Operators must comply by June.

items.excerpt: 1. AI everywhere. 2. On-demand transport is the future. 3. Rail returns…

items.excerpt: Der Landkreis richtet einen bedarfsgesteuerten Rufbus ein. Das Angebot ersetzt zwei wenig genutzte Linienbusse.
